name: Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti
shortBio: Nigerian anti-colonial political thinker, Pan-Africanist, and founder of the Abeokuta Women's Union who theorized and organized grassroots mass collective solidarity against colonial taxation and autocratic native authorities.
centralQuestion: How do colonial taxation and indirect-rule chieftaincy extract wealth from women's labor, and how does grassroots collective solidarity restore democratic accountability?

keyWorks.title: We Are Not Asking for Charity: AWU Petitions and Anti-Taxation Manifestos
keyWorks.description: Collected civic petitions and Pan-African speeches articulating no-taxation-without-representation and Yoruba women's economic democracy.
